I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

- **Source:** Ilse said it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. I also passed on Ilse's tip: don't unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets.
- **Status:** I found no later update on the ticket, and #help-it-ops has no messages at all, so I told her it may still be open.
- **Not included:** I left out everything else from that chat, including the comment about a freight-account spreadsheet left on the room's screen.
